{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Botani''''' was the name given to three [[Muurian transport]]s used by the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]]. These ships were attacked by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces lead by [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Vader]] who were capturing Bothans to find more information regarding an [[Raid on the Suprosa|incident]] with the ''[[Suprosa]]'', a freighter which was carrying a [[Suprosa supercomputer|supercomputer]] carrying data regarding the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|Second Death Star]]. Despite assistance from [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] from [[Junker Squadron]] and [[Logan Squadron]], and [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wings]] from [[Yme Squadron]], all three transports were disabled and captured, along with [[Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle]] [[Com 1]].
